model: Existing efficient-training conditional model; frozen daily banks; paper-trial minimum training dates=3

definitions.profitable: Known recorded execution outcome with netBps strictly greater than zero.
definitions.allStressProfitable: All three execution scenarios known and each netBps strictly positive.
definitions.completeSixActionAllStressOrigin: All 18 action/scenario outcomes known at that asset-origin.
definitions.primaryBlocker: Uses model support/data reason first; on support-ready paths, min scenario predicted mean <=0, (0,1], or uncertainty/tail when every mean >1 but score <=1.
definitions.independentForecastCounter: worstForecastNonpositive is counted regardless of support, so support-gated paths can also have negative expected returns.

limitations: Outcome-defined opportunities are an ex-post oracle, not signals known at entry.
Only the archived 31-minute probe grid is observed; this is not a census of one-second live opportunities or the entire 14-hour interval.
Action paths share origins; six actions and three scenarios are correlated, and the two datasets are inspected development data.
Recorded stops, targets, fills, latencies, fees, quantity and horizons are unchanged. No raw market data was replayed.
Counting alternative profitable paths ignores simultaneous portfolio conflicts; these counts are not realizable portfolio profit.
Unknown outcomes are never assumed to be zero or profitable. Restriction changes and additional training cannot establish predictive edge without new evaluation.

liveObservation.interpretation: At this snapshot every action passes sample/date requirements, but every displayed net mean is negative and every action fails the score. The current absence of entries is not explained by a market-data warmup or training timer.
